ancestry.inheritancePolicy: No cross-record inheritance. Same-record subraces may inherit the parent base image; any subrace-specific variant is a separate optional original, only when an approved visual distinction is needed. Do not infer count of variants from record count.

weatherTime.basis: four day phases + four sky states + four lunar phases; no invented temperature icons

activeFactionAndDeityCandidates.selection: All active faction refs in src/campaign/world.ts plus Aldric deity in seeded party; no symbolic details inferred.

activePartySpells.selection: 16 unique spells explicitly listed on seeded Bo and Lyra; spell names and source IDs verified against SRD spell data. Not a claim these are all active-party spells.

derivedCounts.note: Counts are separate family deliverables; spell-specific pictures are a proposed selected sample. All 12 weather/time concepts have count slots, but clear currently lacks even a procedural glyph. Existing world-and-travel PNGs cover only human/dwarf/elf/halfling and 4 place families.
